tasks.verify:
## Setup
- Use the monorepo example-dev-server / Playwright config from repo root. Do not run Playwright from the example folder.

## Automated
- pnpm exec tsc --noEmit in examples/neon-corridor-strike if the example exists
- pnpm exec playwright test tests/browser/neon-corridor-strike-shot-visual.spec.ts tests/browser/neon-corridor-strike.spec.ts --config playwright.config.ts --workers=1

## Manual / visual
- Open tests/reports/neon-corridor-strike/shot-before.png, shot-during.png, shot-after.png, and first-load.png yourself.
- Fail if gunfire is a yellow blob, cube stack, or white plane.
- Fail if characters are unreadable, shaking, or standing on floating white shards.

## Gotchas
- Passing tests without looking at PNGs is a fail.
- If the example was deleted, verification is: those paths are gone and the handoff names the failing evidence.
